semiconductor_relevance: High — Noritake specializes in grinding, polishing, cutting, and filtration equipment essential for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Noritake Shanghai Trading Co., Ltd. provides advanced equipment and materials for grinding, polishing, and cutting in the semiconductor industry. Their innovative products, such as slurry-free polishing pads and fine bubble ceramic filters, aim to enhance productivity while minimizing environmental impact.
capabilities: SiC wafer CMP pads (LHA Pad®) for slurry-free polishing
Grinding and backgrind wheels for various materials
Advanced polishing pads for GaN and oxide films
